EXPERIMENT / 2026 / CONCEPT PROJECT

Mesh studies.

Interactive prototype

Finding unexpected forms at the intersection of mathematics and motion.

THE IDEA

Simple rules. Unexpected forms.

A study in how simple rules can create surprisingly organic forms. A grid becomes a surface, the surface folds, and a familiar shape starts to feel unfamiliar.

This experiment draws a parametric surface directly on a canvas. Change the shape below to explore how a few numbers can change its character. Move your pointer over the surface to shift the perspective.
